summary: Install containerized AAP from the installation directory with `ansible-playbook -i <inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.install` after preparing hosts, nodes and the inventory.
questions: How do I run the containerized AAP installer?

answer_card.title: Run the containerized install
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd <installation_directory>
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.install
```
Run as the non-root install user after preparing the host, managed nodes and inventory.
